## 📢 Latest News

- 2025-12-31: MindIE SD introduces sparse Attention computation.

- 2025-12-25: vLLM Omni x MindIE SD delivers native high-performance inference for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511/Qwen-Image-Layered on Ascend.

- 2025-11-30: MindIE SD is officially open-sourced and publicly available. [Meeting Calendar](https://meeting.ascend.osinfra.cn/?sig=sig-MindIE-SD)

## 🚀 Overview

Mind Inference Engine Stable Diffusion (MindIE SD) is a view generation inference suite within MindIE, designed to provide an end-to-end inference solution for Stable Diffusion (SD) series models on Ascend hardware and its software stack. The system integrates functional modules internally and exposes a unified programming interface externally.

Below are two MindIE-SD repository AI agents. Simply click the "Ask AI" badge to access their dedicated pages, which help ease source code comprehension and provide an intelligent code learning and Q&A experience. They will assist you in gaining a deeper understanding of MindIE-SD's operational principles and help resolve issues or errors encountered during use.

## 📦 Installation Guide

**Quick Start**

```bash
pip install mindiesd
```

For details about other installation methods and circular dependencies, see [Installation Guide](docs/en/installation.md).
